__page_title__: Abdellah Edaoudi | Full Stack Web Developer
__page_description__: Abdellah Edaoudi — Full Stack Developer from Laayoune, Morocco. Expert in React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, building secure and scalable web apps.
منصة SaaS لإنشاء محافظ مهنية، تتيح دعم ت: An SaaS platform for creating professional portfolios, offering multilingual support, custom domains, theme selection, and CV generation. It includes an admin dashboard for managing content, subscriptions, and analytics. Built with Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, PayPal, and Cloudinary.
نظام للحجز الفندقي والدفع الإلكتروني، يو: A hotel booking and online payment system that provides e-tickets and email confirmations. It includes an admin dashboard for managing bookings, payments, and customers. The project uses Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Stripe, JWT, and Cloudinary.
نظام للمحادثة الفورية يتضمن، وفق السيرة: A real-time chat system featuring, according to the CV, end-to-end encryption, as well as user and conversation management and secure authentication. Built with Next.js, Node.js, Socket.IO, MongoDB, JWT, and Bcrypt.
واجهة خلفية للتجارة الإلكترونية لإدارة ا: An e-commerce back end for managing users, product catalogs, carts, orders, coupons, and Stripe payments. It is based on a clean, scalable API architecture and uses NestJS, TypeScript, MongoDB, Stripe, JWT, and RBAC.
منذ أكتوبر 2025، يؤسس Abdellah Edaoudi و: Since October 2025, Abdellah Edaoudi has been founding and developing an SaaS platform for creating professional portfolios using Next.js, with PayPal integration and custom domain support. Responsibilities include developing REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, authentication using JWT, NextAuth.js, and RBAC, improving performance and SEO through SSR, and deployment on Vercel with CI/CD, Git, and GitHub.
خلال التدريب من سبتمبر 2023 إلى يونيو 20: During the internship from September 2023 to June 2024, worked with React.js, JavaScript, back-end services, and REST APIs using Node.js and Express.js, and gained experience with Laravel, PHP, MongoDB, and MySQL. Also learned Agile/Scrum and used Docker, Git, GitHub, and SonarQube.
في مارس 2024، طوّر تطبيقًا متكاملًا لإدا: In March 2024, developed a full-stack task management application with JWT authentication and REST APIs tested using Postman, then deployed the application on Vercel.
من نوفمبر 2022 إلى يونيو 2023، أنجز مشار: From November 2022 to June 2023, completed programming and algorithms projects and developed websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP. Also worked with SQL databases and learned the fundamentals of information systems security.
